chunks: Dāwūd ibn al-Ḥuṣayn narrated from Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Baqbāq, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "Does a man marry a bondwoman without the knowledge of her owners?" He said: "It is zinā. Indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, says:
Then marry them with the permission of their owners.

key_terms.أَهْلِهَا: her owners or those in authority over her

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to marry a bondwoman without the permission of her owners?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that marrying a bondwoman without the permission of her owners is invalid and treated as zinā. The Imam عليه السلام supports this ruling by citing the Qur'anic command requiring the permission of her أهل.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4560 - Dawud ibn al-Husayn narrated from Abu al-Abbas al-Baqbaq, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as): "Can a man marry a bondwoman without the knowledge of her owners?"
Imam (as) said: "That is considered fornication. Indeed, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says:
'Then marry them with the permission of their owners'
